title: Intercalation of anticancer drug Palbociclib with calf-thymus DNA: new insights from molecular spectroscopic, molecular dynamic simulations and cleavage studies.
authors: Durga Priyadharshini, R; Jeyashree, R; Preethi, R; Vennila, K N; Elango, Kuppanagounder P
one_liner_zh: 该文通过光谱、分子对接和元动力学模拟研究抗癌药Palbociclib与小牛胸腺DNA的嵌入结合及诱导切割，属广义蛋白-DNA互作体系外的药物-DNA互作，方法可迁移至TF-DNA界面建模，但对象非TF-DNA。
abstract: The interaction between the anti-cancer drug Palbociclib (PAL) and calf-thymus DNA (CT-DNA) was investigated using various biophysical techniques in a physiological buffer (pH 7.4). It was found that PAL intercalated into the base pairs of CT-DNA as evidenced from the results of UV-Vis, fluorescence, circular dichroism (CD), competitive binding assay with ethidium bromide (EB) and Hoechst 33258, KI quenching study, the effect of denaturing agent and viscosity measurements. The magnitude of binding constants (10(6) M(-1)) at different temperatures suggested strong binding between PAL and CT-DNA during complexation. The observed DeltaH(o) > 0 and DeltaS(o) > 0 indicated that the binding process is primarily driven by hydrophobic interactions. Molecular docking studies indicated partial intercalation of pyridopyrimidine ring between the base pairs of DNA. Free energy surface (FES) analysis derived from metadynamics simulation studies revealed the PAL-induced cleavage of DNA, which was confirmed by gel electrophoresis experiments.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 采用多种生物物理技术在生理缓冲液（pH 7.4）中研究了抗癌药物帕博西尼（PAL）与小牛胸腺DNA（CT-DNA）之间的相互作用。结果表明，PAL嵌入CT-DNA的碱基对中，这通过紫外-可见光谱、荧光光谱、圆二色（CD）光谱、与溴化乙锭（EB）和Hoechst 33258的竞争性结合实验、KI淬灭研究、变性剂效应及粘度测量得以证实。不同温度下结合常数（10(6) M(-1)）的大小表明，PAL与CT-DNA在络合过程中存在强结合。观察到的ΔH° > 0和ΔS° > 0表明，该结合过程主要由疏水相互作用驱动。分子对接研究表明，吡啶并嘧啶环部分嵌入DNA碱基对之间。基于元动力学模拟研究的自由能表面（FES）分析揭示了PAL诱导的DNA断裂，这通过凝胶电泳实验得到确认。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
